description: Fetch SEVERAL specific articles in ONE call — use this instead of many lookup_article calls when an answer cites multiple provisions (common in law: 15–20). Pass a list of {law, article, paragraph?, point?}. Returns each article's exact in-force text with its citation; for a repealed act, its note once (and, on a plan that includes point-in-time reads, each article's text tagged [ABROGATED]).

items.description: The articles to fetch, up to 25: each {law, article}, optionally with paragraph and point.

law.description: The act, however it is at hand: a citation ('Legea 265/2022', 'HG 1/2016', 'Ordinul 2594/C/2008'), a common name ('Codul fiscal'), a title any tool printed, or 'normele de aplicare a Legii X'.

paragraph.description: Optional. One alineat to return, e.g. "1" or "1^1".

point.description: Optional. One point (pct.) to return, e.g. "42".

name: lookup_articles
